lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Gym Rat.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Gym Rat?
Yes?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Why didn't you come to the gym today?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I was going to show you

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: the new equipment that arrived today.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Gym Rat?
Sorry, I don't feel too good today.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Oh,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: If you're not feeling well, it's better to rest.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: If you push yourself too hard,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: you're liable to get injured.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Did you see the doctor?
No, it's not that bad.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I know you're the best judge of your own body,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: but still, I'm a little concerned.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Can you tell me exactly what's wrong?
My whole body has been aching for the past few days.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: So, you've been feeling unwell for a few days now?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Sounds like you've overexerted yourself with your recent workouts,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: and you finally reached your limit.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: It's my fault.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I should have paid more attention to your condition.
No, it's my fault for hiding it.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: That's no excuse.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Even if you were trying to keep it hidden from me,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: as your trainer,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I should have known.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I'm really sorry.
No, seriously, it's fine.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: How about I make it up to you?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I can come over and give you a massage.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Your muscles must be terribly sore.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I know a technique that can alleviate that pain.
Well, if it's not too much trouble...

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: It's no trouble at all.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I'll finish up this last set and come right over.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Just wait a little bit.
